title: Open Worktime observation
description: Privacy-minimal community observation for actual weekly working time.

id.description: Client-local or server-assigned opaque report identifier.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country or region code for the reported work.

facility_id.description: Canonical Open Worktime facility identifier when the site can be resolved to the facility catalog.

facility_text.description: Fallback site name supplied by the contributor when no canonical facility is available. Must not contain personal names, employee IDs, phone numbers, or email addresses.

weekly_hours_bucket.description: Half-open buckets: 35_40 means 35 <= hours < 40; gte_75 means 75 hours or more.

period_basis.description: The contributor reports their average actual weekly working time over the last four complete weeks.

submitted_at.description: Submission timestamp. This is used for freshness and historical aggregation, not as proof of employment.
